integrity: The foundational publication date and Brusselator provenance were checked against a bibliographic record carrying the exact date 15 February 1968. The exact polynomial equations and primary differential-dynamics classification were checked in an open same-object mathematical article. A complete 2026 same-object global phase-portrait article was compared at statement and implication level and searched for conditional, expectation, covariance, variance, moment, and average formulations. scientific_limitations: The invariant measure is assumed compactly supported inside the strictly positive quadrant.
The support barrier is necessary for stationary recurrence and is not a sufficient oscillation criterion.
The theorem does not determine periods, amplitudes, phase distributions, or full invariant densities.
The foundational article is not used for a whole-document novelty exclusion.
A short equivalent conditional-moment observation could remain in unindexed chemical-oscillation literature.
title: Fiberwise nullcline calibration and exact anticorrelation in the Brusselator
